title: Low-Overhead Multi-Agent Runtime with Memory and Knowledge
oneLiner: Agno provides a lightweight Python runtime for building fast-instantiating multimodal agents equipped with persistent session memory, hybrid vector search, and AgentOS monitoring.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Agno provides a lightweight Python runtime for building fast-instantiating multimodal agents equipped with persistent session memory, hybrid vector search, and AgentOS monitoring.
steps: Monitor runs via AgentOS control plane.
configSnippet: "Create a research Team with a web search agent and a financial analyst agent sharing persistent SQLite session memory."
limitations: Rapid API evolution from Phidata to Agno requires pinning package versions in production.
